description: The menu on a session row in the sessions sidebar, opened by right-click (press and hold on touch) at the pointer. Its items depend on whether the session is on this machine or on a host, its state, and whether it can be a Bot. A Bot row has the same menu.
opens: right-click a session row (not the open unsaved chat, not a ghost)

phone.does: Opened by a long-press on a session or Bot row, at the finger; Move to Group's list opens in place of the items, with a back row first

parts.name: Rename…
parts.shows: "Rename…". Shown for every session except a gone host's. Opens the Rename dialog (RenameSession.dialog.json).

actions.does: Same, on the focused or selected row.

parts.name: New session
parts.shows: "New session", for a Bot whose host is up (not deactivated, not gone): right after Rename…, before the Bot items. No dialog or form.

actions.does: Opens a blank chat for a new chat of the Bot's, on the Bot's host, in the Bot's folder and group, on the Bot's model and effort, with the usual text box and header controls. It is nested under the Bot (spawned_by) once its host has it, and is a draft till something is sent in it: left empty, it leaves nothing behind. What is written in it goes only to that new chat, never to a plain one: the host starts the chat before its first message goes, and if the host doesn't start it the text stays in the box (on the phone the host starts the draft as it's opened, so nothing is written before it has) and "<host> didn't start it: <why>" is said in a toast. On the desktop the draft opens in the open window, its row "New session" is listed under the Bot once something is typed, and the status line shows the Bot's folder on its host, this machine or another. Until the chat is open, the text stays in the box, the send button is off, and the draft stays; leaving for another chat or a new one keeps the text in the box it goes to.

decisions.said: The agent that built New session added a setup dialog the owner hadn't asked for; New session should open a normal lazy draft, with no modal (paraphrased, relayed by the coordinator, the owner's own message not found by owner_said.py)
decisions.rule: A Bot's New session opens a normal lazy draft for one of its child chats, on every app: no modal and no setup dialog; the host, model and folder are picked in the header like any new chat's, and the chat is made on its host only on the first send

parts.name: Bot items
parts.shows: Only for a top-level session on a host that is alive, supports Bots, and runs a model of Claude's, pi's or Codex's program (not a fork): either "Make Bot…" (a plain chat) or both "Bot Settings…" and "Turn Back into a Chat" (a Bot). They sit right after Rename…, before Move to Group.

actions.does: Opens the Make Bot / Bot Settings dialog (BotSettings.dialog.json).

actions.by: click Turn Back into a Chat
actions.does: The host lists it as a plain chat again; its memory and picture stay on the host for if it is made a Bot again.

decisions.said: Can a codex agent become a bot? … Yes
decisions.rule: Every app offers Make Bot…, Bot Settings… and Turn Back into a Chat on a Codex chat as on a Claude or pi one; a Codex Bot is told its name and memory, has Baude's chat tools and the mesh's tools, and may write its memory's folder without being asked

parts.name: Rotate
parts.shows: "Rotate", for a Bot on a host that's up and takes rotate, whatever its model: right after Bot Settings… (before Turn Back into a Chat), or right after Rename… for a Bot that has no other Bot items. No confirmation, as Archive has none. Shown greyed out (disabled) while the Bot is working or waiting, as Archive is.

actions.does: Its host archives the Bot's conversation as a past thread named "<Bot name> / <its title>" (its date if it has no title), and the Bot carries on in a new, empty chat with a new agent. The Bot keeps its id, name, picture, memory, tasks and their runs, browser, rules and the chats it started, and its place in the list: it isn't moved up till something's said in its new chat. A window or phone with the Bot open shows the new, empty chat. The past thread is listed under Archived and found by a search (by the Bot's name or its title); opened, it is read-only, as every archived chat is; it isn't a Bot. A Bot at a turn, asking, running a command or agent in the background, or answering one of its tasks' asks is refused: "<host> didn't rotate it: <why>" in a toast.

decisions.said: Once a Bot has committed its chat to memory, the owner wants to archive that chat and roll the Bot over to a fresh one with right-click → Rotate; the old threads stay searchable as Bot name / thread title (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: A Bot's row menu has Rotate, on every app: the Bot's conversation becomes an archived, read-only past thread named "<Bot> / <title>", findable by search and under Archived, and the Bot keeps everything else in a new, empty chat

decisions.said: Rotating a Bot's chat shouldn't bring it to the top; the message sent right after it should (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Rotate leaves the Bot where it was in the list, on every app: the Bot is listed as last used when its old conversation was; the first message said in its new chat moves it up, as any message does

decisions.said: Rotate and Archive shouldn't be hidden while the agent is working; both should stay shown and be greyed out instead (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app keeps Rotate and Archive visible in a session's row menu while the agent is working or waiting, disabled (greyed out) rather than hidden

parts.name: Move to Group
parts.shows: A submenu, for any chat (this machine's or a host's), after Rename… and any Bot items (first if there is no Rename…). Lists each group by name (those made, those chats are put in, and those hosts' sessions were started in), alphabetical, the chat's own ticked; then "No Group"; then, in a separate section, "New Group…".

actions.by: click a group or No Group
actions.does: Puts the chat in that group (or none); the list and the ⋮ → Groups list refresh. Undo is not offered.
Asks for a name (GroupName.dialog.json); the group is made and this chat moved into it.

parts.name: Archive / Unarchive
parts.shows: "Archive" for a normal session, "Unarchive" for one that is already archived (here, in Claude Desktop, or on its host). While a session is at a turn (working or waiting), Archive stays shown greyed out (disabled), with Stop offered after it for a host session. For a session of this machine's own: archived only in Baude's settings, listed under Archived. On a host: archived there, for every app.

actions.does: Moves it to the Archived group (or back). An archived chat is read-only, its text box gone, until it's unarchived (MenuActions, Read-only session). A host that refuses says "<host> didn't archive it: <why>" / "…didn't unarchive it: <why>" in a toast.

decisions.said: Rotate and Archive shouldn't be hidden while the agent is working; both should stay shown and be greyed out instead (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app keeps Rotate and Archive visible in a session's row menu while the agent is working or waiting, disabled (greyed out) rather than hidden

parts.name: Stop
parts.shows: Only for a session on a host that is working or waiting (and not gone): "Stop".

actions.does: Stops its claude (its host keeps the session to carry on with).

parts.name: Access…
parts.shows: "Access…", for a chat on a host that's up, just before Move to Trash…; not for a Claude Desktop chat the host only lists (taken_up false), which goes by the host's rule. Opens Chat Access (ChatAccess.dialog.json).

decisions.said: Individual chats should have override policies for agent management (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: A host chat's row menu has Access…, before Move to Trash…, on every app

parts.name: Move to Trash…
parts.shows: "Move to Trash…" Opens the confirmation (MoveToTrash.dialog.json). Not shown for a session on a gone host (see Delete).

parts.name: Delete
parts.shows: Only for a session whose host is gone (dead) or not alive: the sole item: "Delete". Its transcript is the host's, so it's only hidden from the list until it shows up again (used since, at a turn, or its host back); Archive keeps a session out for good.

actions.does: The session is hidden from the list; if it's the open chat, a new session opens in its place.

decisions.said: Bot Settings, Rename and the other right-click actions on the sidebar's rows seemed broken (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: What a row's menu does shows in its row as soon as the host answers (a Bot made, renamed, its picture changed, or a chat again included), and the list isn't rebuilt while a row's menu is open, so the menu stays open while any chat on any host changes

decisions.said: Right-click menus jitter and sometimes close as the button comes up; they should show on the press and go on the release (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: A row's menu opens as the right button goes down and stays open as it comes up; held and let go over an item, that item is chosen

states.name: this machine's session (plain)
states.shows: Rename…, Move to Group ▸, Archive (or Unarchive), Move to Trash…. Order: Rename…, Move to Group, Archive, Move to Trash….

states.name: host session, idle
states.shows: Rename…, [Make Bot… | New session, Bot Settings…, Rotate and Turn Back into a Chat], Move to Group ▸, Archive, Access…, Move to Trash….

states.name: host session, working or waiting
states.shows: Rename…, [Make Bot… | New session, Bot Settings…, Rotate (greyed out) and Turn Back into a Chat], Move to Group ▸, Archive (greyed out; an archived one at a turn shows Unarchive), Stop, Access…, Move to Trash….

states.name: host session, host gone
states.shows: Move to Group ▸, Delete. (Rename… is absent.)

states.name: host session, deactivated
states.shows: As gone: Move to Group ▸, Delete.

removed.name: Give Mesh Tools / Remove Mesh Tools
removed.why: Mesh tools are not handed to chats one by one: a Bot has them and Meta has them, always, and no other chat does
